$doc: dev-routine pipeline. Stages run in the repo root (prep: in a clean checkout of the candidate). Placeholders: {skill} {skills} {root} {version} {out}.

deploy.title: Tag the release
deploy.note: Lightweight tag on the candidate's commit on main (an annotated tag records the real time). pipeline.js released does this.

deploy.title: Push the release tag
deploy.note: No packager is linked to this repo, so this doesn't publish by itself.

deploy.title: Test the zip in game
deploy.manual: With the game closed: node <wow-mod-dev>/scripts/wow-env.js profile zip dist/WaterboyReimagined-{version}.zip --client _forever_; log in once, no errors; then wow-env.js restore --client _forever_.

deploy.title: Upload to CurseForge (project 1799428)
deploy.manual: Files > Upload file: dist/WaterboyReimagined-{version}.zip, display name 'Waterboy Reimagined {version}', release type Release, game version WoW Forever, changelog from dist/WaterboyReimagined-{version}-changelog.md, no related projects. See RELEASING.md.

deploy.title: Update the CurseForge listing
deploy.manual: Project > Edit: name, summary, categories and description (the README) from docs/listing.md; screenshot titles from its captions; add the GIF. See RELEASING.md step 5.

deploy.title: Match the GitHub repo
deploy.manual: After your OK: gh repo edit --description "<summary from docs/listing.md>" --add-topic class (topics as listed).

intake.name: CurseForge comments
intake.note: Check the real slug once the project is approved.
